mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(remaining_amount), 0) from ai_credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and remaining_amount > 0 and (expire_time is null or expire_time > sysdate())

select batch_id, user_id, source_type, source_id, total_amount, remaining_amount, expire_time, remark, create_time, update_time from ai_credit_batch where user_id = #{userId} and remaining_amount > 0 and (expire_time is null or expire_time > sysdate()) order by case when expire_time is null then 1 else 0 end, expire_time asc, batch_id asc for update
